goals.title: 기존 실험을 초기화하거나 무시하지 않고 이어받아, Person->Hobby와 Person->Person ML 실험에 필요한...
goals.objective: 기존 실험을 초기화하거나 무시하지 않고 이어받아, Person->Hobby와 Person->Person ML 실험에 필요한 코드/문서/실험계획을 전부 정리한다. 산출물은 두 실험 트랙별 코드 인벤토리, 문서 인벤토리, 기존 결과 요약, 다음 실험계획, LLM Wiki 링크 구조, 그리고 실행/검증 명령이어야 한다. 소스코드는 필요하다고 확인된 경우에만 최소 수정하고, 기본은 문서와 계획 artifact 정리다.

successCriteria.scenario: tmux channel: create a transcript that lists the final organized experiment docs and verifies both track inventories exist. Exact invocation: tmux new-session -d -s ulw-qa-c001; tmux send-keys -t ulw-qa-c001 'rg -n "Code Inventory|Document Inventory|Next Experiment Plan|Already Completed Results" docs/llm_wiki/person_hobby docs/llm_wiki/persona_similarity .omo/plans/recommender-continuation-experiment-plan.md' Enter; tmux capture-pane -pS -200 -E - -t ulw-qa-c001 > .omo/ulw-loop/evidence/G001-C001-doc-coverage.txt; tmux kill-session -t ulw-qa-c001. PASS iff transcript contains all four section names for both ML tracks.
successCriteria.expectedEvidence: .omo/ulw-loop/evidence/G001-C001-doc-coverage.txt contains Code Inventory, Document Inventory, Next Experiment Plan, Already Completed Results for both Person->Hobby and Person->Person tracks; cleanup receipt confirms tmux session killed.
successCriteria.capturedEvidence: .omo/ulw-loop/evidence/G001-C001-doc-coverage.txt has 17 lines covering Code Inventory, Document Inventory, Next Experiment Plan, Already Completed Results for both docs/llm_wiki/person_hobby and docs/llm_wiki/persona_similarity plus the continuation plan. cleanup: tmux unavailable in Git Bash; no long-running session or process was spawned.
successCriteria.notes: Equivalent Git Bash rg transcript used because command -v tmux returned empty.

successCriteria.scenario: tmux channel: run a boundary check proving the two ML tracks are separated and no result summary tells agents to restart from scratch. Exact invocation: tmux new-session -d -s ulw-qa-c002; tmux send-keys -t ulw-qa-c002 'rg -n "Person -> Hobby|Person -> Person|Do not put|Do not merge|continue|not restart|not start from scratch" docs/llm_wiki/person_hobby docs/llm_wiki/persona_similarity .omo/plans/recommender-continuation-experiment-plan.md' Enter; tmux capture-pane -pS -200 -E - -t ulw-qa-c002 > .omo/ulw-loop/evidence/G001-C002-boundary.txt; tmux kill-session -t ulw-qa-c002. PASS iff transcript contains explicit boundary language for both tracks and continuation/not-restart language.
successCriteria.expectedEvidence: .omo/ulw-loop/evidence/G001-C002-boundary.txt contains explicit boundary language for both tracks and continuation/not-restart language; cleanup receipt confirms tmux session killed.
